'''Seven Flames''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] established a support [[Unidentified Rebel base (Seven Flames)|base]] on the planet, which the Rebels used to launch a [[Primitive Sentient Protection and Alliance, Operation 265-A: Karra|diplomatic operation]] to the planet [[Karra]] in an attempt to gain an alliance with the native [[Karran]]s. However, the mission was unsuccessful, though the [[Alliance Diplomatic Corps|Rebel diplomatic team]] was able to return to the base on Seven Flames with Karra's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Darryn Edalm]] in [[Prison/Legends|custody]].

==Description==
Seven Flames was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="ST" /> of the [[Seven Flames system/Legends|Seven Flames system]], within the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]], situated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a large conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], a team of [[Alliance Diplomatic Corps|Rebel]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]], including [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Elth Nardah]] and his assistant, [[Karvinna Raen]], departed from a [[Unidentified Rebel base (Seven Flames)|Rebel base]] on Seven Flames. The Rebels hoped to arrange an alliance with the native [[Species/Legends|species]] of the planet [[Karra]], primitive [[Hive mind/Legends|hive-minded]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] known as the [[Karran]]s. The Rebel [[Primitive Sentient Protection and Alliance, Operation 265-A: Karra|mission]] was initially successful, until Karra's Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Darryn Edalm]], surrendered to the Rebels, who agreed to take him into [[Prison/Legends|custody]]. The Karrans, who wanted the Governor [[Death/Legends|dead]] on sight, proceeded to attack both the Rebel team and Edalm, though the Rebels were able to repel them. Eventually, the Rebels made it off Karra with the former Governor, returning to the base on Seven Flames.<ref name="ST" />

After reaching the base, the diplomatic team was separated from the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]], who proceeded to interrogate the former Imperial, while the Rebel team was escorted to a comfortable room, where they spent the next [[Standard week/Legends|week]], [[Sleep/Legends|resting]] and undergoing debriefing sessions conducted by a [[Unidentified protocol droid (Seven Flames)|protocol droid]]. Ultimately, Edalm&mdash;who was not able to supply the Rebels with any useful information about the Empire&mdash;was transferred offworld to the planet [[Shimmer]].<ref name="ST" />

==Inhabitants==
The Rebel Alliance's base on the planet was staffed by several Rebels, including agents of Alliance Intelligence, some personnel of the Alliance Diplomatic Corps, and at least one [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]].<ref name="ST" />

==Locations==
During the Galactic Civil War, the planet was home to a Rebel Alliance support base, which contained some rooms, including a comfortable suite and a debriefing room.<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
Seven Flames was first featured in the [[1994]] [[roleplaying game]] adventure "[[Stranded]]," written by [[Chuck Truett]] and published within the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 1]].<ref name="ST" /> In [[2009]], the planet was mentioned in the reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square J-19.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
